description: Implementation of OS-specific functions for Posix systems, including process management, file I/O, and system configuration utilities, used within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: ScopedPipe
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of a POSIX pipe, ensuring proper closure of file descriptors.

classes.name: PosixProcess
classes.description: Represents a POSIX process, handling process creation, output capture, and termination.

methods.name: ReadFromFile
methods.description: Reads data from a file descriptor into a string, handling interruptions.

methods.name: ReadEntireFile
methods.description: Reads all data from a file descriptor into a string until EOF.
